name: VALUE
description: VALUE converts a text string that represents a number, date, or time into its underlying numeric value.
tldr: Turns number-like text into an actual number.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text enclosed in quotes or a cell reference containing text that looks like a number.

basicExample.explanation: The quoted text is parsed into the numeric value 123.45.

advancedExamples.title: Convert currency text
advancedExamples.scenario: A cell A1 contains the text "$1,000"
advancedExamples.description: Strip formatting and get a number
advancedExamples.explanation: VALUE understands currency symbols and thousand separators, returning the numeric 1000.

advancedExamples.title: Convert a time string
advancedExamples.explanation: Times are stored as fractions of a day, so 6:00 AM equals 0.25.

howItWorks: VALUE parses the text using the workbook's locale settings for decimals, thousands separators, currency, dates, and times, and returns the corresponding serial number. In modern Excel, many functions coerce text automatically, so VALUE is less often required.

howToSteps.name: Locate the text
howToSteps.text: Find the cell whose text looks like a number.

howToSteps.name: Verify the type
howToSteps.text: The result is now a real number usable in math.

limitations: If the text is not recognizable as a number, VALUE returns #VALUE!.
Date and time parsing depends on the system locale.
Largely redundant in modern Excel because arithmetic and functions auto-coerce text numbers.

commonErrors.cause: The text contains non-numeric characters VALUE cannot interpret.
commonErrors.fix: Clean the text with functions like SUBSTITUTE or CLEAN before converting.

commonErrors.cause: Locale uses a comma as the decimal separator but the text uses a period.
commonErrors.fix: Match the text format to the workbook locale or use SUBSTITUTE to swap separators.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: VALUE works the same way in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Is VALUE still needed?
faq.answer: Often not; arithmetic and functions like SUM auto-convert text numbers, but VALUE is explicit and clear.

faq.question: Does VALUE handle dates?
faq.answer: Yes, it converts date/time text into the underlying serial number.

faq.question: What is the opposite of VALUE?
faq.answer: TEXT, which formats a number back into a text string.
